query: SELECT to_jsonb(result) AS "value!" FROM (SELECT 'project' AS kind,p.id,p.name,p.id AS "projectId",p.name AS project,NULL::text AS environment FROM projects p WHERE strpos(lower(p.name),lower($1))>0 UNION ALL SELECT 'service',s.id,s.name,p.id,p.name,e.name FROM services s JOIN environments e ON e.id=s.environment_id JOIN projects p ON p.id=e.project_id WHERE strpos(lower(s.name||' '||p.name||' '||e.name),lower($1))>0 ORDER BY kind,name LIMIT 30) result
